query_normalized: investigating correlations between molecular descriptors and drug-likeness scores chemistry
rationale: This paper belongs in the literature review because it addresses the foundational methodology (category d) and the core domain of Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) modeling, which is the standard framework for investigating correlations between molecular descriptors and drug properties (category a).
